cc:Work.dc:title: f04_few_column
cc:Work.dc:description: A dispatch matrix distinguishes scalar loop B, grouped scalar C1 and few-column C4. Each contrast retains twelve code and twelve math root effects plus its geometric summary. The primary C1/B interval crosses zero; both descriptive C4 intervals favor the candidate. A separate arithmetic waterfall shows verification savings outweighed by prefill cost, ending at a net cost of 80.52 milliseconds. All signed values and the zero lines remain visible.
